newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Daiwa Assoc says not gotten takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Assoc says not gotten takeover bid.

text.p: Daiwa Associate Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had not received any takeover bid and it had no share placement plan.
"The board of directors has not received any takeover bid. There is also no present intention of issuing shares by way of placement or rights issue," the company said in a statement.
Shares of Daiwa Associate, which surged HK$0.235 or 52.8 percent last week, gained a further HK$0.16 or 23.5 percent to HK$0.84 in late Monday morning trade.
"There is no recent substantial change in the net asset value per share of the company and there is also no substantial change in the business of the group," the statement said.
